ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Long Shade
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
LONGSHADE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1, Phase A row 2 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md (parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1, governed by BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1). The Long Shade — RM_LongShade — is a dayside desert band at a sun so low every stone throws a shadow four times its own height: nothing lives in the light and nothing survives leaving shelter, so life here is a sprint between islands of shade. Name ruled 2026-09-21 (biome_mod_architecture.md §7 Q2, the owner's own recommended row): "the Long Shade", off `RUT_Desert`'s sheet identity, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ biomes/desert.md (FROZEN, BIOME_FREEZE_FABLE_REVIEW_1).
RM tier: this def names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet, terrain + 16 native creatures + 5 native plants only. LONGSHADE_RULED_CONTENT_1 (2026-09-27 sitting) moved 14 invented-name animals and the ultracactus in from the Utinni patch layer, RENAMED off their RSW_ defNames — this mod carries no Star Wars reference of any kind any more. Native wild fauna: JOE_Landopus, JOE_Cephalope (absorbed non-Star-Wars donor fauna, own defs, §7 Q9), plus RM_Bokka, RM_Ossik, RM_Kudda, RM_Thurra, RM_Vosska, RM_Khorrak, RM_Ommok, RM_Ulgga, RM_Jellypot, RM_TruffleMole, RM_GreatDevourer, RM_Groundrunner, RM_MatureFleshbeast and RM_Gloomcast (the former shade whale, RULED name — Q5). Native flora: RM_Vorrel (the desert's cycle plant, moved and renamed here from mandrake.rut.ashkarrflora per §7 Q8), RM_Leachmoss and RM_Venomvine (mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards, MayRequire-guarded), RM_Ultracactus (Q2: "not canon, I made it") and RM_Dewfringe (new, Q6 — a shade-boundary rim plant, growth confined to the rim by its own small Harmony patch). Its foragedFood is a real standalone item, RM_UltracactusPad (Q3), closing the same inert-forage gap DESERT_FORAGEDFOOD_INERT_1 fixed one tier down. Five more Star Wars-tier wild plants (mandrake.rsw.swbestiary, MayRequire-guarded) stay wired inline at their existing weights, same shape as every other RimMandrake biome mod's still-open wildPlants MayRequire gap (§7, item 4).
The remaining `RSW_`/`SW_`-tier and campaign-tier creatures (37 rows: the canon Star Wars cast, the whale's own commensal, and Dewback — herd/mount stock added this same sitting, Q8) are OUT of this def by design (§7 Q11/Q12: RimMandrake never names Star Wars) and ride src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_LongShade.xml as a PatchOperationAdd onto RM_LongShade, MayRequire="mandrake.rsw.swbestiary" — this mod alone, with nothing else loaded, keeps its own 16 creatures plus whatever the Mod Settings screen leaves enabled from the shared shade-grid / contact-venom kits (mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards — loadAfter only, no hard dependency; both already ship their own global toggles for those mechanics) and this mod's own new dewfringe rim-gate toggle.
The `RUT_Desert` twin in mandrake.rut.patches is FROZEN, not deleted — it carries the player's saved campaign world until the terminal paint (BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1). Every content fix for the Long Shade lands here from now on.
